mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome—I'm so glad you're here with me. Together, we're about to dive into a conversation that pulses with real questions about identity, gender, and all the contradictions that come with being a modern woman. Ever find yourself wrestling with big ideas about equality, but also laughing at the little ways life just doesn’t fit the script? That’s exactly the space Roxane Gay explores in her powerful work, Bad Feminist. She invites us to look honestly at the messy, sometimes awkward crossroads where our personal imperfections meet the big ideals of feminism. And honestly, isn’t that where so many of us live? Along this journey, we’ll wander through pop culture, race, privilege, and all the everyday moments that shape what it means to be a woman right now. We’ll explore how loving things that aren’t always “politically correct,” making mistakes, and still dreaming of something better—all of that—can coexist. What I love about Roxane Gay’s approach is how she opens up the conversation, making space for honesty, humor, and a little bit of forgiveness—for ourselves and for each other. So, as we step into these stories and reflections, let’s be curious, open, and ready to challenge what we think we know about feminism. Together, let’s discover what it really means to be a “bad” feminist in a world that’s constantly demanding perfection.
